blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Let's peek inside.
exercises.why: **заглянуть → заглянем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let Tom have his fun.
exercises.why: **повеселиться → повеселится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Does it bother you if I smoke?
exercises.why: **закурить → закурю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Не ___ (понять), где у него спина, где брюхо.
exercises.prompt: You don't get where his back is, and where his belly is.
exercises.why: **понять → поймёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Screw it in tight.
exercises.why: **завинтить → Завинтите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's play house!
exercises.why: **поиграть → поиграем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Do you want to walk together?
exercises.why: **пройтись → пройдёмся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Hold on to the strap. The train will start to move soon.
exercises.why: **двинуться → двинется** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: This particle turns a noun into a verb.
exercises.why: **преобразовать → преобразует** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Wait until the crowd scatters.
exercises.why: **рассосаться → рассосётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я уверен, что Том в конечном счёте ___ (объявиться).
exercises.prompt: I'm sure Tom will turn up eventually.
exercises.why: **объявиться → объявится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: There is a bridge over the pond.
exercises.why: **перекинуть → перекинут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: В следующем году Викисловарю, проекту Викимедиа, ___ (исполниться) двадцать лет.
exercises.prompt: Next year, the Wiktionary project from Wikimedia will turn 20.
exercises.why: **исполниться → исполнится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: The mason will build the house.
exercises.why: **построить → построит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Stop. I don't want to.
exercises.why: **прекратить → Прекратите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You'll be punished if you break the law.
exercises.why: **преступить → преступишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Надеюсь, мы не ___ (натолкнуться) ни на какие бюрократические препоны.
exercises.prompt: I hope we don't run into any bureaucratic red tape.
exercises.why: **натолкнуться → натолкнёмся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Have you tried this cake? It's to die for.
exercises.why: **облизать → оближешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I doubt if sanctions will work.
exercises.why: **сработать → сработают** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Эй, этот узел никуда не годится. Лодка ___ (уплыть).
exercises.prompt: Hey, that knot is no good. The boat will float away.
exercises.why: **уплыть → уплывёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
